integrity: Exact finite-sample proof, tested truncated-normal integrations and Monte Carlo checks; no independent validation or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Centered stationary Gaussian AR(1) only; threshold is standardized by marginal standard deviation, and quadratic energy is not sample-centered. General Gaussian-chaos treatments might imply a special case; Sinn–Keller full text was unavailable for comparison.
title: A universal level threshold for upcrossing–energy covariance in a Gaussian autoregression
